entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This place really is an oasis[n]right in the middle of the city.[n]I can feel the trees' energy!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I honestly enjoy just[n]relaxing like this.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It makes me think of a picnic...[n]And now I'm craving sandwiches.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Then, is it okay if they're the[n]sweet kind? With whipped cream[n]and custard inside...?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh? But they're totally[n]different. Well, I guess[n]both have carbs though...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh... How about we put dumplings[n]inside of a sandwich!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It is both clean and[n]refreshing, after all.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...I wonder if I could get[n]full just from taking deep[n]breaths of it.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Anyway, it really is quiet here...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I know! Let's take a walk!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I want to see what else is[n]around... Want to come with?
